content_data.meeting_title: Q3 Sales Performance Review & AI Integration Strategy
agenda_items: Training needs analysis for new AI sales tools
Deep dive on new AI-powered lead scoring system adoption and initial impact
Open forum for team challenges and best practices
key_decisions: Allocate additional resources for specialized training on the AI-powered predictive analytics platform for all sales representatives.
Prioritize follow-up on leads generated by the new AI scoring system, focusing on accounts with high-confidence scores.
action_items: Individual sales reps to review their pipeline for the upcoming period and identify 3-5 high-potential deals to accelerate using AI insights. (Owner: All Sales Reps, Deadline: +5 days)
Research and compile a competitive analysis report on 3-5 key competitors' AI-powered telecom solutions. (Owner: Market Research Analyst, Deadline: +14 days)
